Every entry in this section of the official C++ Core Guidelines, in their order. Each link opens the official text. "ours" links the pages of this repo that cite the rule; "example" and "test" link our own example and unit test for it.

[Official section](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#s-source) · [All sections](README.md)

- [SF.1: Use a `.cpp` suffix for code files and `.h` for interface files if your project doesn't already follow another convention](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-file-suffix) · no example: a file-naming convention (`.cpp` and `.h` unless the project already uses others, such as `.cc`/`.hpp`); the official rule defers to NL.27.
- [SF.2: A header file must not contain object definitions or non-inline function definitions](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-inline) · [example](examples/source.md#sf2-a-header-file-must-not-contain-object-definitions-or-non-inline-function-definitions)
- [SF.3: Use header files for all declarations used in multiple source files](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-declaration-header) · [example](examples/source.md#sf3-use-header-files-for-all-declarations-used-in-multiple-source-files)
- [SF.4: Include header files before other declarations in a file](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-include-order) · [example](examples/source.md#sf4-include-header-files-before-other-declarations-in-a-file)
- [SF.5: A `.cpp` file must include the header file(s) that defines its interface](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-consistency) · [example](examples/source.md#sf5-a-cpp-file-must-include-the-header-files-that-defines-its-interface)
- [SF.6: Use `using namespace` directives for transition, for foundation libraries (such as `std`), or within a local scope (only)](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-using) · [example](examples/source.md#sf6-use-using-namespace-directives-for-transition-for-foundation-libraries-such-as-std-or-within-a-local-scope-only)
- [SF.7: Don't write `using namespace` at global scope in a header file](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-using-directive) · [example](examples/source.md#sf7-dont-write-using-namespace-at-global-scope-in-a-header-file)
- [SF.8: Use `#include` guards for all header files](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-guards) · [example](examples/source.md#sf8-use-include-guards-for-all-header-files)
- [SF.9: Avoid cyclic dependencies among source files](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-cycles) · [example](examples/source.md#sf9-avoid-cyclic-dependencies-among-source-files)
- [SF.10: Avoid dependencies on implicitly `#include`d names](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-implicit) · [example](examples/source.md#sf10-avoid-dependencies-on-implicitly-included-names)
- [SF.11: Header files should be self-contained](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-contained) · [example](examples/source.md#sf11-header-files-should-be-self-contained)
- [SF.12: Prefer the quoted form of `#include` for files relative to the including file and the angle bracket form everywhere else](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rs-incform) · [example](examples/source.md#sf12-prefer-the-quoted-form-of-include-for-files-relative-to-the-including-file-and-the-angle-bracket-form-everywhere-else)
